readerAfter:
“Hey, Ciel. What does ‘Blackout Moon’ mean?”
―――Rejected.
Or so I’d like to say, but so many people have asked that I’ll answer.
You can black out when you’re ill, or be left in the dark during a blackout.
So the title gives us a sick, dizzy moon and a dark moon at the same time.
